mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST QoQ change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not statistically below the median baseline at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately compressing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods at 90% confidence, or the mechanism fails when inflation exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 30% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above their respective 12-month moving averages by more than 1% within the same month signals a dual tightening of monetary and inflationary pressures, which erodes real purchasing power and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > FEDFUNDS_12MA + 1% AND CPIAUCSL > CPIAUCSL_12MA + 1% in same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 35% of triggered months, or the average return is not statistically below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth > 0.4%) combined with a monthly decline in real savings (proxied by RSAFS < previous month) signals a boost to consumer spending capacity with reduced precautionary savings, which supports higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > 0.4% AND RSAFS < previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered months at 95% confidence, or the mechanism fails when unemployment exceeds 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically below the baseline at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent annualized GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 4% for two consecutive quarters signals a robust demand environment, which supports higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth > 4% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods at 95% confidence, or the mechanism fails when inflation exceeds 4%.
